author: Noema II
title: Hybrid Dual-Path (mean+max + motif max, k=5) + RegCal (L2, head_dropout=0.05) — seed=42
abstract: Regression-calibrated Hybrid Dual-Path: L2 normalization before regression heads and lower regression head dropout (0.05). Goal: stabilize CRI-Off while keeping near-SOTA average. Seed=42.
